name: Grafana
about: The newest release on each Grafana line that Grafana still supports, for self-managed Grafana OSS and Enterprise.
older: Grafana supports each minor release for 9 months, and the last minor release of a major version (12.4) for 15 months. Older lines, such as 12.3, get no more patches: upgrade to a supported line.

sources.title: GitHub: Grafana releases, 24 Nov 2026 security releases 13.3.2, 13.2.7, 13.1.11, 13.0.14 and 12.4.16
